diagnostic.title: Course Prerequisite Diagnostic Assessment
diagnostic.description: Evaluate your readiness in linear algebra, multivariable calculus, and basic Python.

questions.question: What is the Euclidean norm $\|v\|$ of the vector $v = [1, 2, -2]^T$?
If matrix $A$ is of shape $3 \times 4$ and matrix $B$ is of shape $4 \times 2$, what is the shape of $A B$?
questions.explanation: Inner dimensions match (4=4). Product shape is $(3 \times 2)$.

questions.question: For $f(x, y) = x^2 y + 3y^2$, what is the partial derivative $\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}$?
questions.explanation: Treat $y$ as a constant: $\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(x^2 y + 3y^2) = 2xy + 0 = 2xy$.

questions.question: Two non-zero vectors $u$ and $v$ are orthogonal if and only if:
questions.explanation: By definition, the dot product of orthogonal vectors is zero: $u^T v = 0$.

questions.question: In NumPy, what is the shape of `a = np.array([[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]])`?
questions.explanation: There are 2 rows and 3 columns, so `a.shape` is `(2, 3)`.
